name: Rootlace Hollows
placement: Shallow below mature forests and old wooded hills; avoid desert and bare alpine summits
geometry: Short branching pockets beneath soil and tree trunks, low ceilings with root curtains
description: Shallow tunnels threaded with exposed roots, dark rich soil, fallen debris and small mushroom patches, often connected to the forest floor
note: These are region-selection design weights, not probabilities; normalize only after hard geological/depth eligibility constraints.
